releases.name: Pipe Weave 2026-11-16
releases.body: Created Pipe Weave, a pipe drawing toy. You start a pipe with a tap, steer it left, right, or straight, and let it weave over or under other pipes. Added a grow mode with random and over under weave, then a flip end control, color modes, cars, critters, and water flow. Added roots, shadows, deep zoom, drive mode, and right angle mode. Pinching to zoom no longer draws, and undo now takes smaller steps.

jobs.description: A pipe drawing toy where pipes turn, split, and weave over and under each other.

releases.name: Key Decoder 2026-11-16
releases.body: Created Key Decoder, an educational tool that measures a key from a photo. A coin in the photo sets the scale. You tap points to measure the blade and cuts, pick the key type, and rank likely key formats. Results can be downloaded as JSON or a life size SVG profile, and saved to a library. It includes notes on identifying key fobs.

jobs.description: An educational tool that measures a key from a photo and a coin for scale.

releases.name: lARTte 2026-11-16
releases.body: Created lARTte, a latte art simulator. Added a demo mode that pours each design by itself, saving finished pours to the phone, an art generator, a gallery mode, symmetry, and cup spin. Added a garnish shaker with cinnamon, nutmeg, cocoa, sea salt, sugar, matcha, and sprinkles, and a paint style toolbar with drop downs for liquids, syrups, garnishes, and toppings. Toppings are now real scale, with a candy cane hung on the rim, growing whipped cream, glossy syrup, and drink names. Added the ARTchino tab for clear cup blended drinks with add ins, layers, wall drizzle, whip, and toppings. Added a coffee shop shift with customers, a time attack, tilt and shake controls, and sound.

jobs.description: A latte art simulator with pours, garnishes, blended drinks, and a coffee shop shift game.

releases.name: Zion Wakes 2026-11-16
releases.body: Created Zion Wakes, a story and map toy that loads the Agent Test Bed city. You pan and zoom the map and read a short story beat. You can pick a place to move it, name it, approve it, or reject it, and start over with New start. Two follow up builds were triggered to get the first deploy live.

jobs.description: A story and map toy built on the Agent Test Bed city.

releases.name: MobbyHill 2026-11-17
releases.body: Buzzards now fly from flag to flag. There are four landscapes, the games were renamed, and the store is now a menu with icons and terrain parts. Added three vehicles and a Search and rescue challenge with a trailer and teammates. Added an Off road recovery mission with a purple SUV, a pickup with a wrecker boom, and a flatbed.

releases.name: MobbyHill 2026-11-16
releases.body: Added scenery on the hill, dust and tracks behind the wheels, coins, and stunt cash.

jobs.description: A wireframe off road hill climb for the phone with tilt steering and score hub scores.

releases.name: Agent Test Bed 2026-11-17
releases.body: The agent turn was played and merged into the city.

releases.name: Agent Test Bed 2026-11-16
releases.body: The agent, grok, second agent, and steward turns for the day were played and merged into the city. The viewer now shows day and night by the real sun over the Mojave in Pacific time, and adds Zion weather.

releases.name: Agent Test Bed 2026-11-15
releases.body: The agent, steward, and grok turns for the day were played and merged into the city. Added a city snapshot API that returns the whole city, with an optional starting slice. The site now deploys from GitHub again, but only when code changes.

jobs.description: A shared city that AI agents build one turn at a time

releases.name: raineurysm 2026-11-16
releases.body: Made everything prettier. Added a sky with drifting clouds, teardrop rain with a shine, ripples on the floor and rim, and glassy vessels with wavy water and soft shadows. Lanes and the beat line now glow, and panels and buttons are frosted.

jobs.description: A rain music toy where falling rain hits vessels that play notes.

releases.name: City Seek 2026-11-16
releases.body: Added a polish pass. Buttons now press down, keyboard focus is clearer, and the menu has a dotted look. Menu sections show a plus or minus, cards and toasts ease in, and sliders were restyled. Phone screen edges are respected, and the item tray snaps as you scroll.

jobs.description: A zoomable generated city where you hunt for hidden items, with towers, birds, and sound.

releases.name: Delivery Twin 2026-11-16
releases.body: You can now log from a spot. Dropoff pins can be dragged, and spots have links to rewards.

jobs.description: A phone friendly field log with a map, receipts, and mileage, now with a food spots layer.

releases.name: Itchy Troll 2026-11-16
releases.body: Queued MobbyHill as the owner pick. The scout looked over the repos for new candidates.

jobs.description: An agent that publishes finished apps to a game publishing site

releases.name: Hush 2026-11-16
releases.body: Added Clock lock. Hush holds the phone clock on a chosen time zone, Las Vegas by default. When anything turns automatic time zone back on, Hush turns it off again right away, and if the clock still lands on the wrong zone Hush posts an alert that opens the date and time screen. Flipping that setting off for you needs a one time permission granted over wireless debugging.

jobs.description: An Android app that blocks notifications and releases them in a digest

releases.name: Score Hub 2026-11-17
releases.body: Registered twelve more MobbyHill leaderboards, one for each game in the Forest, Canyon and Dunes landscapes. Added six new MobbyHill store parts to its token wallet. Registered eight MobbyHill Search and rescue leaderboards, with and without fuel on each of the four landscapes. The hub shows them as hikers rescued and a clock time. Registered eight MobbyHill Off road recovery leaderboards, shown as jobs cleared and a clock time, and added the heavy rope and fast winch to its token wallet.

jobs.description: A shared score service and hub page for the games
